text:
tom-eng: Hey finance — contractor @vendor-echo submitted their invoice but payments flagged them as missing a W-9. They asked if Redwood can pay them and then gross-up for backup withholding. Invoice INV-5582 attached.

vendor-echo: Hi! Sorry about the W-9 delay. I'm a US person but misplaced my SSN paperwork. If you pay now and withhold, I'll sort the W-9 next week. Would prefer to avoid 24% backup withholding if possible.

jamie-payments: We can't pay without vendor onboarding complete. System flagged the vendor as 'TIN missing' which triggers backup withholding rules. If they don't provide a valid W-9, payments default to 24% backup withholding.

priya-finance: Quick policy note: we don't do voluntary gross-ups for backup withholding. Company policy is to pay net after required withholding. If vendor provides W-9 within X days and it's valid, we can reverse and remit difference. Need legal confirmation for reversals.

leo-legal: Confirming: we will not gross-up for backup withholding. Vendor can provide a completed W-9 (PDF or US gov efiling screenshot) with name matching invoice and TIN. If W-9 comes after payment and proves TIN valid, we can file adjustment and release outstanding amount per AP reversal process.

vendor-echo: Ok understood. I'll send completed W-9 today. If you need a redacted SSN on the copy (last 4 digits only) while verifying, that's fine.

tax-bot: Reference: IRS backup withholding rules — 26 CFR 31.3406. Payments team: mark invoice INV-5582 for manual review. If W-9 received before ACH cutoff (tomorrow 07:00 UTC) we can avoid withholding.

jamie-payments: Noted. Manual hold placed. Please upload W-9 to vendor onboarding portal and notify @priya-finance. If not received by cutoff we'll process payment with 24% backup withholding and issue 1099-B reporting.

priya-finance: Thanks everyone. @vendor-echo upload the W-9 and confirm the name exactly as it appears on the invoice. We'll follow up once verified.

vendor-echo: Uploaded W-9 now (last 4 redacted). Thanks for the fast turnaround :+1:

jamie-payments: Got it. Verifying SSN/TIN. Will update thread after verification and before ACH run.

priya-finance: Closing loop: please keep the payment thread here. If verification fails, we'll proceed with withholding and provide remittance summary.
